summary: Tested all 4 new AtelierAI Try-On features end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_tryon_favorites.py with 7 tests, ALL PASSING against production URL — covers new side_file_id + rear_file_id in /api/tryon/generate response, both file ids retrievable via /api/files/{id}, POST /api/tryon/sessions/{id}/favorite returns is_favorite=true + pixel_avatar_id + auto_pixel_created=true on first call and false on second (idempotent), GET /api/tryon/favorites lists only favorited sessions, POST /api/tryon/sessions/{id}/unfavorite removes from favorites. Pixel avatar auto-created by favoriting is marked auto_generated=true and shows up in /api/pixel-avatars. Frontend (Playwright, tryon_test@example.com): logged in, ran full 3-step flow with mock adapter, verified tryon-result renders with a composited image (result differs from raw garment). view-switcher has all 3 buttons (view-front/side/rear) — clicking each switches between tryon-view-front / -side / -rear panes. virtual-tryon-placeholder-badge text correctly states 'Side and rear are approximations derived from the front image (mirror + tonal shift) — this is not a true 3D rotation' (per No Fake AI rule). add-to-favorite button toggles label 'Add to favorite' → 'Favorited' after click; pixel-avatar-preview panel appears with link-view-avatar. /wardrobe: tab-favorites is DEFAULT active tab with count badge ('Favorites 2'), favorite-{id} cards render with rendered image, favorite-unfav-{id} button, and favorite-avatar-{id} badge. tab-avatars shows pixel avatars including auto ones with 'auto' in metadata; images actually render (naturalWidth=384). tab-sessions (Try-On History) exposes session-fav-{id} heart buttons — the two favorited sessions show fill-current (filled gold) class, others are outline; clicking a filled heart triggers 'Removed from favorites' toast and Favorites count drops 2→1. All 4 requested features working.

minor.issue: Returns {"ok": true} instead of the richer {is_favorite: false} shape used by /favorite — inconsistent contract but functionally correct (session flag is flipped in DB).

critical_code_review_comments: Naming mismatch: request spec refers to a 'tab-history' testid in Wardrobe, but implementation uses tab-sessions (functionally correct). Consider aligning naming for consistency with the docs.
Endpoint response shape: /unfavorite returns {ok: true} while /favorite returns full session-like dict — consider unifying so the client can read is_favorite from either.

WardrobePage.jsx also seems to have session-fav on the Try-On History cards but no tests assert the count-badge decrement in real time — currently works because React refetches; a stale-cache path could regress silently.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded products; created several try-on sessions + pixel avatars during test — all owned by test user)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested try-on features (realistic composite render, add-to-favorite, auto pixel avatar on favorite, wardrobe Favorites tab with heart toggle) verified end-to-end. Multi-view side/rear are Pillow approximations by design — banner correctly discloses this per No Fake AI rule; do NOT flag as bug. HF adapter path not retested (out of scope). Note tab testid in Wardrobe is tab-sessions (not tab-history) for the Try-On History tab.
